independent_reviews.text:
# Summary

No additional material defect found in the bounded read-only review of the exact 12-file independent-boundary observation layer. All 12 draft hashes and eight existing-file base hashes matched its manifest. No code, tests, Cargo, native worker, provider, or fixture was executed.

## Scope and evidence

Read the complete patch and all four new modules, the design and its independent review, and the adjacent production Control, active-observation, registration, report-collection, and archive paths.

- The actual RuntimeCoordinator callback verifies the identical Control Arc, exact operation registration, original contract Arc, full Permit digest, still-active registration and unjoined state under one validate_permit callback. It clones the actual contract and admitted budget, then drops RuntimeState before protected receipt and cache-only independent-gate reads. Registration.verify_active_owner, operation, and active_independent_gate do not reenter Control or invoke provider transport.
- The admission check recomputes the existing complete ordinary model request identity from the actual permit and finite budget, and requires the exact protected Prepared admission without an observed result. This diagnostic cannot infer a registration from matching serialized data.
- The existing retained active-gate path preserves admitted configuration choices while checking fresh exact PR selection/text/head/base and permissions. The contract diagnostic also binds scope, work key, source revision, context and instruction identities. No general current_authority/effective-evidence search supplies this diagnostic.
- Host callback errors and malformed matched diagnostics are converted to Unavailable. The source snapshot, checks, effects and review observations are not discarded by that new callback. Existing unrelated errors in the preexisting observe path remain errors; this layer does not claim to repair them.
- Grading copies the optional diagnostic before scorer loading/grading. Archive validation checks its shape and, for matched actual-agent reports, the instruction/operation/workspace/context/permissions/tool bindings. Legacy absence stays absent; the DTO is never an authority or grade-success input.
- Authored tests are explicitly real Control/protected-storage components, actual ScopedWorker with an unavailable generic host, and report/grading data plumbing. They do not manufacture a registered native worker or a matched runtime capability.
